0022600105.text: Both teams are 0-1 after one game, with the Nets sitting 10th in the East and the Cavaliers 11th, and this is Brooklyn's second game of the season. Nets forward Tyler Bilodeau is out with a shoulder injury. In 2025-26 the Nets lost the season series 0-3, most recently 106-102 at home in Brooklyn on March 1, 2026.
